measure: Reported offenses in on-campus student housing per 1,000 documented fall student residents.
residential_scope: Approximate normalization until housing-property boundaries are reconciled with Clery geography.
source_strategy: One fixed federal collection for primary comparison; source-specific ASR alternatives and discrepancies retained.
pooling: 1000 * sum(counts) / sum(matched annual populations); never an unweighted mean of campus/year rates.
uncertainty_decision: Descriptive ratios; no hypothesis tests or confidence-interval safety ranking.
ucsc_2024_note: ASR housing rape count 38 includes 21 separate offenses disclosed in one report over three weeks; all 38 remain in source counts.
ucsd_revision_note: ASR PDF page 142 explicitly revises 2022/2023 counts; two 2022 rape cells differ from the fixed federal collection.
